summary: The current land development and utility locate intelligence indicate strong builder activity primarily in Gaston, Union, and Mecklenburg counties, with a particular land and locate signal concentration in Gaston County around Bessemer City. Several large parcels in Cleveland County under the ownership of multiple LLCs show very high watch scores, signaling strategic land holdings and potential development interest. Union County is also noteworthy with numerous active residential zoning and economic development cases poised for upcoming Board of Commissioners discussions. Builder activity is robust with multiple established and selling communities from D.R. Horton and Eastwood Homes, especially in Gaston and Mecklenburg. Utility locate requests and land development proximity signals present actionable opportunities to engage near tracked parcels, often correlated with high watch scores, suggesting early-stage development triggers. GIS parcel mapping and locate pattern data reinforce Gaston County, especially Bessemer City, as a key watch area for utility infrastructure coordination and land development monitoring.
key_findings: 7 high watch score parcels clustered in Cleveland County owned by strategic LLCs, all >300 acres.
Gaston County shows multiple high-opportunity utility locate requests in Bessemer City with 10-16 tracked parcels within 3 miles reflecting concentrated development signals.
Union County exhibits strong residential and economic development pipeline with multiple zoning and incentive public hearing items scheduled for mid-2025.
Builder presence is concentrated in Gaston and Mecklenburg with D.R. Horton and Eastwood Homes actively selling and launching communities.
No significant locate pattern emergence outside Gaston with moderate to high confidence scores linked to clustered land parcels.
